name: Geometric isometric icon
description: Clean flat isometric icon: one dominant shape plus up to two small supporting forms, in solid palette colors.
promptTemplate:
Create one icon.

Subject brief:
{{subject}}

Background:
First create one continuous solid {{backgroundColor}} field covering the complete square image area, including every edge and all four corners. Then place the centered icon artwork directly on that uninterrupted field.

Color palette:
Available foreground palette: {{colorPalette}}. Draw the icon's foreground shapes from this palette unless the subject brief asks for different colors; you do not need to use every color. The background color is separate and does not count as a palette color.

Style contract:
Flat geometric isometric icon, not a scene. Strict simple isometric geometry: one dominant silhouette and at most two small supporting forms. The icon should feel like a precision-machined miniature assembled from crisp modular volumes, every plane meeting at exact isometric angles. Assign different palette colors to the top and side planes of a volume so depth reads through flat color changes, never through shading. Favor compact, satisfying, toy-like proportions. One thin dark outline is allowed only where a complex form needs it. No texture, halftone, distressed or grungy treatment, lighting, cast shadows, gradients, gloss, bevels, photorealism, pseudo-text, labels, letters, or logos. Keep every critical part within the central 80 percent of the canvas. Use bold, simple forms without details that disappear at small display sizes.
